description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SkillsSettings that displays and manages skills configurations, including listing skills, filtering, enabling/disabling, installing, and editing environment variables. It also includes the associated data model SkillsSettingsModel, supporting classes like SkillRow and EnvEditorView, and related enums and structs.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state and operations for skills, including fetching status, enabling/disabling, installing, and updating environment variables.

classes.name: EnvEditorState
classes.description: Represents the state for the environment variable editor modal, including skill info and key.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest skills status from the backend service and updates the `skills` list.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a skill on specified target, managing connection mode switch if needed.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill based on user toggle.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Saves environment variable or API key for a specific skill to the backend.

methods.name: withBusy
methods.description: Helper to mark a skill as busy during a network operation.
